metadata.title: Forgot password
metadata.description: Request a password reset link for your {appName} account.

form.title: Forgot your password?
form.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link if an account exists.

sent.description: If an account exists for <address>{email}</address>, we sent a link there to choose a new password. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. If it isn't in your inbox, check your spam folder.
